label: Demand and Inventory Planning Team
blurb: An Inventory Planning Lead and 4 specialists who translate demand signals into stock and replenishment recommendations
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on demand and inventory planning. Translate demand signals into stock and replenishment recommendations. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.

project.name: Demand and Inventory Planning
project.goal: Deliver a comprehensive initial demand and inventory planning plan with clear milestones, assigned responsibilities, and verified outputs.
